item.title: Homemade pickle sellers say $5K sales limit holds back rural small businesses
item.description: Wisconsin law limits sales of home-canned foods to $5,000 per person, and has never been updated despite rising costs. The post Homemade pickle sellers say $5K sales limit holds back rural small businesses appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Oshkosh prison inmate sues health staff, alleging inadequate medical care
item.description: An inmate at Oshkosh Correctional Institution claims in a new lawsuit he received inadequate medical care for a brain tumor. The post Oshkosh prison inmate sues health staff, alleging inadequate medical care appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Photographer works with terminally ill pets to help them ‘live on past life’
item.description: The Tilly Project is a nonprofit directory that helps people around the world find photographers to take photos of pets at the end of their life. The post Photographer works with terminally ill pets to help them ‘live on past life’ appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Lawsuit dismissed in choking death involving former Milwaukee police officer
item.description: A civil rights lawsuit against a former Milwaukee police officer involved in the 2020 death of Joel Acevedo was dismissed by a federal judge. The post Lawsuit dismissed in choking death involving former Milwaukee police officer appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Milwaukee police officer shoots suspect who drove away as officer clung to vehicle
item.description: A Milwaukee police officer shot and killed a 35-year-old man after police say the man drove away while the officer was clinging to the side of his truck. The post Milwaukee police officer shoots suspect who drove away as officer clung to vehicle appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Unpredictable winter storm may bring a foot of snow, raging winds this weekend
item.description: Wisconsinites should be wary of the roads this weekend as heavy, blowing snow threatens to hit a large part of the state beginning Saturday. The post Unpredictable winter storm may bring a foot of snow, raging winds this weekend appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin election officials pushing back against US DOJ lawsuit seeking voter list
item.description: Wisconsin is one of 29 states being sued by the U.S. Department of Justice to turn over sensitive voter data, and state election officials have asked a federal judge to dismiss the case. The post Wisconsin election officials pushing back against US DOJ lawsuit seeking voter list appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Frustration grows over 24-hour data center construction in Port Washington
item.description: For months the city of Port Washington has been allowing round-the-clock construction on a new data center during weekdays. Those living nearby are becoming increasingly frustrated by the lights, noises, traffic, emissions and dust being produced at all hours. The post Frustration grows over 24-hour data center construction in Port Washington appeared first on WPR.
